description: Zero‑dependency, ultra‑fast Node.js framework that gives Express‑style simplicity with Fastify‑grade performance—perfect for edge, serverless and microservice workloads.
npm_trending_strategy: Leverages the 2026 trend toward edge‑first, serverless architectures by offering a truly zero‑dependency core that stays under 5 KB gzipped, eliminates cold‑start overhead, and ships built‑in async hooks, request tracing, and security headers. Compatibility adapters let you run existing Express middleware unchanged, while native TypeScript types and a declarative plugin API give developers the modern developer experience they expect from Fastify and newer runtimes.
download_hooks: Blazing sub‑millisecond routing with a tiny footprint → instant cold starts on edge and serverless platforms.
Zero‑dependency core means smaller Docker images, faster CI pipelines, and no transitive‑dependency headaches.
Built‑in security headers, request tracing, and TypeScript typings give a frictionless developer experience out of the box.
